## Problem Statement
Is your feature request related to a problem? Describe it.
Example: "I wish I could filter the audit report without editing a spreadsheet..."

## Proposed Solution
How would you like this to work? Be specific.

## Alternative Solutions
Any alternatives you've considered?

## Use Case
Who would benefit from this feature? Why?

## Additional Context
Any other information (links, screenshots, mockups)?

## Difficulty Level
- [ ] Beginner (config changes, simple validation)
- [ ] Intermediate (new classification rule, new mutagen format)
- [ ] Advanced (new phase, fingerprinting, GUI, Windows support)
